description: Scoped capability for the plugin-account window: documents that secret_set / secret_get / secret_del are intended exclusively for the 'account' and 'control' windows. In Tauri v2 the capability system governs plugin permissions; custom invoke_handler commands are additionally enforced via the window-origin check in the command handlers. This file satisfies Rec-1 (feature-review): dedicated capability file, not widening capabilities/default.json.
